feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector predicates for keywords in statics, power-at-most outside events, same-name and shared-type tests, power or mana value compared with another object, attacking-you-only, multicolored, and owner-based selectors.

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values and arithmetic for life gained or lost, damage, excess damage, counters placed, creatures destroyed or exiled by the preceding effect, mana spent, difference, half and power-of-two amounts, and totals such as toughness.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Let become-copy and enters-as-copy keep an ability or add creature subtypes; let token copies gain colors and creature subtypes, be created per creature or under another player's control, enter attacking, be exiled at end step, or carry crew-power, haste and can't-block riders; token creation ops lack the same riders.

feature: Conditional rule statics and permissions
description: Add rule statics for flash grants, spending mana as any type, untap limits, can't-be-blocked exceptions, combat assignment, hand size, life-gain prevention and spell-prohibition scopes.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add effects for the Ring tempting you, earthbend, rad counters, waterbend payments, join forces, villainous choices, incubate and stun counters, plus die rolls and repeated coin flips.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add conditions for what happened this turn (attacked, gained or lost life, combat damage by a source type), cast-zone and graveyard-size checks, and player-versus-opponent life, hand and land comparisons.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add entry options for returned, searched and put-onto-battlefield cards (tapped, attacking, attached, under owner, per player) and library search with split or chosen destinations.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events for scry or surveil, cycling, becoming untapped, an opponent searching, expending mana, a creature entering or dying with extra context, and source, subject and payload filters on cast, damage and attack triggers.

feature: Temporary or permanent characteristic-setting effects
description: Add effects that add creature subtypes, types or colors, or set base characteristics, for a duration or permanently.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost components (return a permanent, mill, tap or exile others, pay X life, discard filters, choice between components, once-per-turn mana abilities) and conditional spell cost reductions.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope and chooser fields so shuffle, sacrifice, draw, exile and create ops can target each player, a chosen player or an opponent, or act for the controller of a countered spell.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add any-number, per-opponent and chosen-count targets and picks, counter removal or movement of any kind or any number, and unbounded reveal picks.

feature: Damage prevention and replacement variants
description: Add partial or continuous damage prevention, redirection and increase, and replacement effects for life gain, drawing and mana loss.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add keywords the schema lacks or cannot grant: cipher, myriad, mobilize, undying, persist, exalted, landwalk, plain partner, vanishing, sunburst, forage and cumulative upkeep.

feature: Alternative-cost keyword mechanics
description: Model suspend, miracle, warp, impending, madness, freerunning, prowl, mayhem, buyback and encore as alternative casts with exile, time-counter and recast riders.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, exile-until and mill-then-pick loops that route the found card and the leftover cards to different places.

feature: Reference to the card moved by the previous effect
description: Let follow-up effects, reflexive triggers and delayed returns refer to the card or permanent the previous effect or a dies trigger moved, sacrificed or exiled, and let control durations survive control changes.

feature: Sacrificed cost object's power/mana value
description: Add Values and references that read the power, toughness, mana value, types or identity of an object sacrificed or exiled as a cost.

feature: Win/lose-game effects and static
description: Add effects that make a player win or lose the game and statics or replacements that stop losing or winning.

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Let effects and targets take the announced X (counts, copies, repeats, search bounds) instead of a fixed number.

feature: Counterspell variants
description: Let counter effects put the spell into its owner's hand or library, compare against a revealed card, charge dynamic amounts, and act on the countered spell's controller or mana value.

feature: Extra turns and phases for other players
description: Add extra turns, combats and beginning phases for other players, controlling another player's turn, and delayed triggers on the next attack.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add free or alternative casting of cards from the command zone, graveyards, opponents' graveyards and exile, with haste, once-per-turn, copy and mana-type riders.

feature: Durations until end of your next turn
description: Allow exile-and-play and restriction effects to last until the end of your next turn or a later end step instead of only this turn.

feature: one-off
description: Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.
